theorems.name: Submission.lipschitz_c1_approximation
theorems.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn p) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → Rn p, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
